content:
Mira: Quick sync — proposal for region-aware routing + tiered fallback for model variants. Want feedback before I put this into the rollout playbook.

Dev: TL;DR requested: how do we pick dest region and when do we fallback model variants? :thinking:

Mira: Plan sketch: prefer customer region affinity, but measure p95/minute; if p95 > 250ms or probe fails, attempt next candidate region based on tier mapping. For model variants: prefer same-variant, but allow quantized fallback when latency/cost threshold crossed for non-enterprise tiers.

Omar: Important: Dedicated/reserved customers must not be failover-targeted to other regions unless they opt in. That needs a hard gate in routing service config.

Lina: Also — model variant fallback can change output. We should not silently switch for premium customers. Need explicit opt-in or console notification.

Mira: Agreed. Rough config sketch below (very rough):

```json
{
  "policy_name": "tiered_latency_affinity_v1",
  "priority_order": ["region_affinity", "latency_probe", "capacity"],
  "tiers": {
    "enterprise": {"allow_cross_region": false},
    "standard": {"allow_cross_region": true, "max_failover_count": 1},
    "free": {"allow_cross_region": true, "max_failover_count": 2}
  },
  "latency_threshold_ms": 250,
  "probe_interval_s": 10,
  "model_variant_fallback": ["fp16", "int8_q", "cpu_quant"]
}
```

Jason: For model_variant_fallback we should consult a precomputed "quality_score" (from evals) and only fallback when delta < 0.02. That avoids surprising regressions.

Rachel: From a Console/UX POV: we need a "Why was my request routed" modal showing: original region, chosen region, reason (latency/capacity/tier), and any model_variant changes. Also a toggle per-customer: allow_cross_region.

Sam-oncall: Observability: every route decision must log trace_id and probe samples. During incidents we need to query route.decisions quickly. Example query: `select count(*) from telemetry where event='route_decision' and reason='latency' and dest_region='eu-west'`

Ella: Autoscaler interaction: when we start failing over traffic to another region, the autoscaler may kick in and scale up — risk of thundering herd. Include capacity_hint in route_decisions so autoscaler can smooth.

Mira: Rollout plan idea: internal-only -> 10% external traffic -> 50% -> GA. Split region-failover canary and model-variant-fallback canary. Monitor p50/p95, error rates, and quality regressions (eval prompts).

Dev: Telemetry schema proposal:
```
route_decision: { customer_id, tier, src_region, dest_region, reason, latency_ms, probe_sample_ts, trace_id, model_variant }
```
Omar: Also update rate-limiter logic: when failover happens ensure we preserve quota windows and counts. Example: do not double-debit if request retries across region.

Lina: Add `X-Model-Variant` header on responses and a small notice in webhook callbacks when variant changes. Also surface cost delta in Console so teams can opt-out.

Mira: Action items: (1) Add gating in routing service for 'dedicated' customers (Omar). (2) Implement quality_score check for variant fallback (Jason). (3) Console UX: show routing_reason + variant diff (Rachel). (4) Telemetry: route_decisions schema + trace_id + capacity_hint (Sam/Ella). (5) Docs & rollout playbook (me).

Jason: +1. I'll draft the quality check PR and include a tunable threshold.

Rachel: I'll mock the Console panel and provide API shape we can use to surface reasons.

Sam-oncall: I'll add a runbook entry for failover alerts and include examples of queries & dashboards.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-service v3.14.2 -> canary us-east-1 :rocket:

Mira: Thanks everyone — I'll update the design doc and tag PRs. :+1:
